english: Otters hold hands while they sleep.
So they don't float away from each other.
I think that's the sweetest thing I've ever heard.

ko: 수달은 잠잘 때 서로 손을 잡아.
내가 들어본 것 중 가장 사랑스러운 이야기 같아.

english: A shrimp's heart is in its head.
Its head, not its chest.
I keep imagining a tiny heart just... up there.

ko: 작은 심장이 거기 위에 있는 걸 계속 상상하게 돼.

english: Bananas are berries.
But strawberries aren't.
I don't know who decided that, but I have questions.

ko: 누가 정한 건지 모르겠지만, 궁금한 게 많아.

english: Cows have best friends.
And they get stressed when they're separated.
I wonder who my best friend would be if I were a cow.

ko: 내가 소라면 누가 내 단짝일지 궁금해.

english: You can't hum while holding your nose.
Try it right now.
I did this three times and I still don't understand it.

ko: 코를 막으면 콧노래를 부를 수 없어.
나는 세 번이나 해봤는데 아직도 이해가 안 돼.

english: Octopuses have three hearts.
One of them stops beating when they swim.
I feel very lazy in comparison.

ko: 그거에 비하면 난 정말 게으른 것 같아.

english: Some trees are older than entire countries.
They were already standing before some countries existed.
That makes me feel very small.

ko: 어떤 나라가 생기기도 전부터 서 있었대.
그 생각을 하면 내가 아주 작게 느껴져.

english: Some dolphins give each other names.
Special whistles just for one friend.
I want a whistle name too.

ko: 한 친구만을 위한 특별한 휘파람 소리로.

english: Honey never really goes bad.
People have found jars of it thousands of years old, still safe to eat.
Honey is basically immortal.

ko: 수천 년 된 꿀 항아리도 아직 먹을 수 있는 상태로 발견됐대.

english: You blink about once every four seconds.
Right now, you're probably thinking about blinking.
Sorry about that.

ko: 사람은 약 4초마다 한 번씩 눈을 깜빡여.
지금 아마 깜빡이는 걸 의식하게 됐을 거야.

english: A flamingo's knee actually bends the other way.
What looks like its knee is really its ankle.
I don't know where its real knee is hiding.
Sharks were swimming before trees existed.
Sharks came first.
Trees are actually the newer invention.

ko: 상어는 나무가 생기기도 전부터 헤엄치고 있었어.
나무가 오히려 나중에 생긴 발명품인 셈이야.

english: A group of flamingos is called a flamboyance.
That feels like exactly the right word for them.

ko: 정말 딱 어울리는 단어인 것 같아.

english: Your nose can remember thousands of different smells.
More than your eyes remember faces.
I never knew my nose was so talented.

ko: 코는 수천 가지 냄새를 기억할 수 있대.
눈이 얼굴을 기억하는 것보다 더 많이.
내 코가 이렇게 재능 있는 줄 몰랐어.

english: Elephants can recognise themselves in a mirror.
Not many animals can do that.
I wonder what they think when they see themselves.

ko: 코끼리는 거울 속 자기 자신을 알아볼 수 있어.
그럴 수 있는 동물은 많지 않아.
거울을 보면서 무슨 생각을 할지 궁금해.

english: Some clouds weigh more than an airplane.
But they still float.
Nothing about that makes sense to me.
Kangaroos can't walk backwards.
Only forward, always.
I think I like their attitude.
Your ears never stop growing.
Even when you're very old.
So somewhere out there is a person with enormous ears, and they don't even know it.

ko: 그래서 어딘가엔 자기도 모르게 귀가 엄청 큰 사람이 있을 거야.

english: A single tree can produce enough oxygen for two people.
Just one tree, quietly doing that all day.
I don't think trees get enough credit.

ko: 나무 한 그루가 두 사람이 쓸 산소를 만들어낼 수 있대.
나무 한 그루가 하루 종일 조용히 그 일을 하는 거야.
나무는 제대로 인정을 못 받는 것 같아.
